List the bookmarks for the given user.

params.description: This ID shares namespace with organization IDs.

params.name: user_ids.email
params.description: Secondary identifier, which can only be used in specific requests.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of results per page.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination. 0 is interpreted as 1.

params.name: order
params.description:
Order the results by this field path.
Default ordering is by ID. Prepend with a minus (-) to reverse the order.

params.name: deleted
params.description: Only return recently deleted bookmarks.

params.name: entity_types
params.description:
Specifies that only bookmarks that reference the given entity type should be returned. If empty the filter is not
applied.

info.name:
Delete a list of bookmarks of the given user.
This operation is atomic; either all bookmarks are deleted or none.
Bookmarks not found are skipped and no error is returned.
